h2o_policy: native_custom_loss_1_minus_macro_f1; five base families plus StackedEnsemble; group-disjoint blending carved from training before preprocessing; GLM may retain internal AUTO; threshold 0.5
threshold_policy: native_predict; H2O uses p1 > 0.5, with ties assigned to class 0; no tuning on test
refit_policy: Keep selected training-only model; TPOT and PyCaret selected instances refitted on the same training data
class_weight_policy: All five frameworks support balanced training weights; PyCaret and TPOT use the same weight-compatible families in every scenario; macro-F1 evaluation remains unweighted
